# Figure provenance - public calculation repository

The public repository does not store the manuscript or its compiled PDF. It stores the code and numerical inputs required to regenerate the corrected v11 numerical plots.

## Regenerated by `scripts/make_figures.py`

The following outputs are written to `figures/`:

| Figure asset | Primary source |
|---|---|
| `linear_to_classical_handoff_corrected.png` | `data/raw/linear_handoff_eps1e-3.npz` |
| `aen_full_two_helicity_current_corrected.png` | `data/derived/relativistic_current_spectrum.csv`, parity control |
| `nonlinear_helicity_seed_robustness_corrected.png` | corrected seed histories + common-support hierarchy |
| `backreaction_vs_linear_helicity_corrected.png` | corrected nonlinear reference + matched linear control |
| `helicity_cascade_heatmap_corrected.png` | reference shell spectrum |
| `nonlinear_kinematic_evolution_corrected.png` | reference nonlinear history |
| `resolved_IR_UV_transfer_corrected.png` | reference shell spectrum |
| `capture_dynamic_range_requirement_corrected.png` | strict-mask bound + derived capture table |

The compact derived tables are rebuilt with `make postprocess`. The relativistic current spectrum is rebuilt with `make relativistic-current`.

## Other manuscript figures

The manuscript also contains analytic/theorem-check visualizations that are not required to reproduce the corrected nonlinear headline results and are not redistributed in this calculation repository. Their equations and claims are stated in the manuscript itself.

## Release rule

Any future public figure whose numerical content depends on `full_proca_solver.py`, the strict de-alias mask, the Wigner initializer, or the corrected relativistic-current quadrature should be generated by a checked-in script and covered by a release test or derived table.
